Name: Spaghetti Marinara
Instructions: 1. Cook pasta according to package instructions. 2. Sauté garlic in olive oil. 3. Add tomato sauce and simmer. 4. Combine pasta and sauce. 5. Garnish with basil.

Name: Beef Tacos
Instructions: 1. Brown ground beef. 2. Add taco seasoning and water. 3. Simmer until thickened. 4. Fill taco shells with beef, lettuce, cheese, and tomato.

Name: Chicken Tikka Masala
Instructions: 1. Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices. 2. Grill or bake chicken until cooked through. 3. Prepare tomato-based sauce with ginger, garlic, and spices. 4. Simmer chicken in sauce. 5. Serve with rice or naan.

Name: Cheesecake
Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Mix cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla. Pour into graham cracker crust. Bake for 20-25 minutes. Let cool and refrigerate.

Name: Pasta with Tomato Sauce
Instructions: Sauté onions and garlic in olive oil. Add diced tomatoes, basil, oregano, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 15 minutes. Serve over cooked pasta.
